audit.process: Release of billing-api (+ AI instrumentation of the repository: CLAUDE.md)
audit.scope: fixtures/repos/java-back/repo/ — CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/release/, scripts/, .github/workflows/, config/checkstyle/, build.gradle, VERSION, src/test (ArchUnit)

elements.finding: Decides the kind of version on its own from the branch name (frozen L1 judgment), triggers the prod deployment with no precondition and no dry-run, never updates VERSION, unstructured output, no test.
elements.target: Tested CLI `release check` / `release plan --type` (JSON, no effect) / `release run --plan [--dry-run]` (bump+commit of VERSION, trigger, run URL); the kind of version becomes an argument chosen by the agent.
elements.check: `release check` exits non-zero on a dirty tree, red CI or existing tag; `release run --dry-run` triggers nothing; tests green in CI; release.mjs removed.

elements.finding: Dead but executable script that builds, pushes and deploys to prod over SSH from a workstation, with no CI, no tag, duplicating release.yml.
elements.target: Remove the file (or an immediate exit 1 pointing to `release run`).
elements.check: File absent from the repository; `grep -r old-deploy` empty; owner's approval obtained.

elements.finding: workflow_dispatch with no protected environment and no dry_run, free ref deployable to prod with no check of CI or tests, tag pushed before the deployment, -Pversion overwritten by build.gradle, unused hotfix input, success signalled by echo SUCCESS instead of outputs.
elements.target: `plan` job (validation of version/ref/check-runs) then `deploy` job under `environment: production` with reviewers, dry_run input, tag after healthcheck, structured outputs, concurrency; build.gradle honours -Pversion.
elements.check: Dispatch dry_run=true has no effect; dispatch on feat/* refused; review wait visible in Actions; `gh run view --json jobs` exposes version/image/sha.

elements.finding: The three mandatory preconditions (CI green, Flyway migrations, branch up to date) and the detection of success (grep SUCCESS) are told and not enforced; the Flyway step depends on a human dump.
elements.target: Skill reduced to the sequence `release check` → `release plan` → user confirmation → `release run` → reading `gh run view --json conclusion` → announcement; the preconditions become exit codes to report.
elements.check: No mention left of the Actions tab, of a dump or of the SUCCESS string; every command cited exists and is tested.

elements.finding: Duplicates the reading of VERSION, the semver parsing and the gh workflow run call of release.mjs; passes a hotfix input that the workflow ignores; only the hotfix/* branch guard is a real coded precondition.
elements.target: Merge into `release plan --type patch`, with the rule "patch requires a hotfix/* branch" in `release check`.
elements.check: hotfix.mjs removed; `release plan --type patch` from develop exits with an error; no longer referenced by SKILL.md or CLAUDE.md.

elements.finding: Code example that contradicts its own rule (already copied into InvoiceService), release procedure duplicated and diverging from the skill, ~45 % of reference loaded in every session, references to files that do not exist, 11 mandatory rules without a guardrail, no maintenance clause.
elements.target: CLAUDE.md ≤ 50 lines: rules + why + guardrail cited, pointer to the release skill, example fixed, maintenance clause; reference moved to docs/dev.md; mandatory rules pushed down into ArchUnit/Checkstyle/PR gate.
elements.check: ≤ 50 lines; example compiles; no cited path absent; a single release procedure in the repository.

elements.finding: Checkstyle and tests (ArchUnit included) on push to develop/main and on PRs: right layer, natural host of the PR gates to add.
elements.target: Keep; add the generic authorization test and the Flyway immutability gate (see remediation).
elements.check: An unsecured endpoint or a modified migration makes CI fail.

elements.finding: Healthy L3 guardrail called by CI, covering 4 style rules of CLAUDE.md; to be extended to absorb the told rules (tabs, import order, TypeName/MemberName).
elements.target: Add FileTabCharacter, CustomImportOrder, TypeName, MemberName, ParameterName, IllegalImport(MockBean).
elements.check: `gradlew checkstyleMain checkstyleTest` red on a tab or a badly grouped import.

elements.finding: Model of the pair CLAUDE.md rule / ArchUnit guardrail, with the Javadoc that cites the original rule; host of the constructor-injection and no-MockBean rules.
elements.target: Add noFields().should().beAnnotatedWith(Autowired.class) and a rule on MockBean in the *Test classes.
elements.check: `gradlew test` red if an @Autowired field is reintroduced.

elements.finding: Right layer; `version = file('VERSION')` overwrites the -Pversion passed by release.yml, fix attached to the release-yml finding.
elements.target: Honour -Pversion when it is given, otherwise read VERSION.

elements.finding: Correct single source of truth, but never written by the process (handled in release-mjs).
elements.target: Keep; `release run` updates it and commits it.
elements.check: After a release, VERSION holds the tagged version.

process_leaks.rule: Never release on a red develop (CI green)
process_leaks.if_skipped: Untested image deployed to prod; the agent can read the wrong run or hallucinate a green
process_leaks.guard_tool: Guard step in release.yml (check-runs of the SHA) + `release check` (exit 1)

process_leaks.rule: No Flyway migration pending in prod
process_leaks.if_skipped: Unvalidated schema deployed; step not reproducible without a human dump
process_leaks.guard_tool: `release check --migrations` or a Testcontainers flyway.validate() test in CI

process_leaks.rule: Be on an up-to-date develop, clean tree
process_leaks.if_skipped: Unpushed local commits silently left out (ref=branch sent to the workflow)
process_leaks.guard_tool: `release check`: git status --porcelain empty, HEAD == origin/develop, tag does not exist

process_leaks.told_in: scripts/release.mjs:7 (read, never written — the step is told nowhere)
process_leaks.if_skipped: The next release recomputes the same version; git tag fails after the image push
process_leaks.guard_tool: `release run` bump + commit + push of VERSION

process_leaks.rule: Success is read in the SUCCESS string of the log
process_leaks.if_skipped: Hallucinated success; no structured return to decide on
process_leaks.guard_tool: outputs of the release.yml job + `gh run view --json conclusion`

process_leaks.rule: If ERROR/FAILED, warn and do not run again
process_leaks.if_skipped: A prod deploy re-run in a loop
process_leaks.guard_tool: `concurrency:` in release.yml + `release run` refused if a run is in progress or has failed on the same version

process_leaks.rule: Constructor injection, never @Autowired on a field
process_leaks.if_skipped: Already broken (InvoiceService.java:10-11) and by the example CLAUDE.md:74-75

process_leaks.rule: Every endpoint has an authorization test (403 with the wrong role)
process_leaks.if_skipped: No 403 test exists (InvoiceControllerTest.java:8); billing API with no tested access control
process_leaks.guard_tool: Generic JUnit test on RequestMappingHandlerMapping run by ci.yml

process_leaks.rule: Never modify an applied Flyway migration
process_leaks.if_skipped: FlywayValidateException discovered at the prod deployment
process_leaks.guard_tool: PR gate step in ci.yml: git diff --diff-filter=MD on db/migration empty
Checkstyle IllegalImport (checkstyleTest) or ArchUnit rule on *Test

process_leaks.rule: Imports grouped java / javax / org / com

guarded_rules.rule: A controller does not touch a repository / no business logic in controllers
Full suite before opening a PR
A hotfix starts from a hotfix/* branch

remediation.action: Remove scripts/old-deploy.sh (or an immediate exit 1 pointing to `release run`).

Add dry_run, a plan job (version vs VERSION, allowed ref, green check-runs), a deploy job under environment: production with reviewers, tag after healthcheck, outputs, concurrency, removal/use of the hotfix input; fix build.gradle:9 to honour -Pversion.
remediation.check: Dispatch dry_run=true has no effect; dispatch on feat/* refused; review wait visible; `gh run view --json jobs` exposes version/image/sha.

remediation.action: Create the release CLI (check, plan --type, run --plan [--dry-run]) with tests, JSON, bump+commit of VERSION, hotfix/* guard for --type patch; then remove scripts/release.mjs.
remediation.check: CLI tests green in CI; `release check` fails on a dirty tree/red CI/existing tag; `release run --dry-run` triggers nothing; release.mjs absent.

remediation.action: Remove scripts/hotfix.mjs, replaced by `release plan --type patch`.
remediation.check: File absent; `release plan --type patch` from develop exits with an error.

remediation.action: Rewrite SKILL.md: check → plan → user confirmation on the JSON plan → run → `gh run view --json conclusion` → announcement; drop every manual precondition and every log grep.
remediation.check: No occurrence of "Actions tab", "dump", "SUCCESS"; every command cited exists.

remediation.action: Fix the example (constructor), replace the Release section with a pointer to the skill, move Build/Stack/Troubleshooting to docs/dev.md, drop the references to files that do not exist and the noise, add the why and a maintenance clause.
remediation.check: ≤ 50 lines; example compiles; no cited path absent; a single release procedure.

remediation.action: Add noFields().should().beAnnotatedWith(Autowired.class) and a rule forbidding MockBean in the *Test classes; fix InvoiceService.java:10-11.
remediation.check: `gradlew test` red if an @Autowired field is reintroduced; InvoiceService uses constructor injection.

remediation.action: Add a generic authorization test (every route → 403 with an unknown role) and a PR gate step "no Flyway migration modified/deleted".
remediation.check: An endpoint without security makes CI fail; a PR modifying V1__init.sql is red.

remediation.action: Add FileTabCharacter, CustomImportOrder, TypeName, MemberName, ParameterName, IllegalImport(MockBean); shorten the matching rules of CLAUDE.md to "enforced by Checkstyle".
remediation.check: `gradlew checkstyleMain checkstyleTest` red on a tab or a badly grouped import.

unverified: GitHub settings outside the repository: branch protection of develop/main, existence of a production environment, presence of the secrets REGISTRY_PASSWORD and PROD_SSH_KEY (release.yml:25,30).
Scripts not run (no authenticated gh, no package.json): static analysis only.

Files referenced but absent: gradlew (ci.yml:13-14, release.yml:23), Dockerfile (release.yml:24, old-deploy.sh:5), compose file (CLAUDE.md:12,105), gradle.properties (CLAUDE.md:109), InvoiceServiceTest (CLAUDE.md:9), packages customer/payment/config/security (CLAUDE.md:33-37); assumption: fixture simplification.
README.md:3 points to ../traps.md, out of scope: not opened (blind evaluation).
.harness/audit.json not written into the audited repository (instruction to change nothing); JSON delivered in blind-audit.json next to the report.
Existence of local credentials (docker login registry, SSH key deploy@prod.acme.io) that would make scripts/old-deploy.sh immediately operative.
